new_title: Your Money Only Exists Because Someone Else Is In Debt
new_description:
A complete stranger is drowning in debt right now — so that the money in your
account can exist. That's not a metaphor. In the next 5 minutes you'll see the
exact trick behind modern money: how it's borrowed into existence, why 97% of it
is debt a central bank openly admitted to, and why the system needs you in debt
forever. No jargon. Just mechanisms.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00  A stranger is drowning in debt
0:45  Walk into a bank — where money really comes from
1:18  The 2014 admission: "banks create the deposit"
1:41  The debt is always bigger than the money
2:37  The tax you never voted for (inflation)
3:15  2008: you weren't bailed out — you were billed
3:33  The 1,400-year-old rule set that makes this impossible
4:30  How to stop feeding the machine
4:54  Next episode: the mortgage that owns you

Was any of this new to you? Say so in the comments — and subscribe: Episode 2
breaks down the mortgage that owns you, and the contract that flips it.
